metas.name: Neagley
metas.description: Neagley, drawing from her experience with Jack Reacher and the 110 Special Investigators, embarks on a perilous mission to expose a sinister threat, risking her life to unravel the mystery. Available on Prime Video in 4K.

metas.name: Nemesis
metas.description: LA crime drama pits master thief Coltrane Wilder against detective Isaiah Stiles, challenging heist genre norms while examining what drives, sustains and destroys people. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Legends
metas.description: Customs agents go undercover to infiltrate Britain's most dangerous drug gangs, following a thrilling criminal investigation based on extensive research and interviews with those involved in the top-secret operation. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Man on Fire
metas.description: Follows John Creasy, a wounded former mercenary on a quest to get revenge for the loss of his only companion while defending the daughter of his dead colleague from the forces that tore her family apart. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: The Dark Wizard
metas.description: An unflinching portrait of Dean Potter, the world's most influential and controversial climber, base jumper and highline walker, who achieves jaw-dropping feats while battling his inner demons. Available on HBO Max in 1080p.

metas.name: Marshals
metas.description: Ex-Navy SEAL Kayce Dutton leaves the Yellowstone ranch to work with an elite U.S. Marshals team. Available on Paramount+ in 4K.

metas.name: CIA
metas.description: Follows a partnership between a C.I.A Case Officer and an F.B.I. Special Agent who work together on a clandestine task force to prevent domestic terrorism in New York. Available on Paramount+ in 1080p.

metas.name: Lord of the Flies
metas.description: After a plane crash, a group of schoolboys find themselves stranded on a tropical island without adults. Ralph is elected leader and, with the help of the intelligent Piggy, strives to maintain order and civilization. Jack, responsible for the signal fire, becomes increasingly focused on hunting and power struggles. This leads to tensions within the group, gradually pushing the boys from hope and structure into chaos and tragedy. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Memory of a Killer
metas.description: When hitman Angelo is hit with early onset Alzheimer's, his worlds collide, putting his family in danger. Available on Hulu in 1080p.

metas.name: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin
metas.description: Showcases a retelling of the Arthurian legend set in a Roman-occupied Britain where barbarian invaders threaten to lay claim to the island. Available on Prime Video in 1080p.

metas.name: Steal
metas.description: A typical day at Lochmill Capital is upended when armed thieves burst in and force Zara and her best friend Luke to execute their demands. In the aftermath, conflicted detective Rhys races against time to find out who stole £4 billion pounds of people's pensions and why. Available on Prime Video in 4K.
